A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Curiosity welcome.

Here’s where things stand.

How does trading work?+

Open Trade, connect your wallet and choose an amount. One transaction begins a simulated portfolio with live prices. STOP closes positions and requests automatic settlement. The landing-page ticket is a preview; Staking brings together rewards and APY; Lending & Borrowing is coming soon. Rewards and APY are part of the yield experience, not separate products.

How will Staking work?+

Staking brings rewards and APY into one product. Deposits are not open yet; the calculator illustrates your own assumptions, not a quoted or promised APY. A ZK privacy layer is also planned. Current Vela transactions remain public until that layer is implemented.

What do the AI agents actually do?+

Vela combines research, signal review and risk management in one agent team. Reversion and pullback signals are internal inputs, not separate products. The app shows whether the research model is connected; signal and risk agents can run independently. The six-role animation illustrates the broader workflow.

What does the $2 stop budget mean?+

The copied execution core limits every account’s per-position stop trigger loss budget to a maximum of $2, including trading fees, while retaining stricter limits. Stops round inward and account for partial exits. This is a trigger calculation, not a guarantee against slippage, market gaps, or funding charges. Portfolio entries use the same fee-inclusive limit.

Which wallets can I connect?+

Choose MyDoge Wallet or MetaMask. MyDoge uses the official DogeOS connection flow, including the native wallet when you open Vela inside MyDoge. MetaMask connects through your extension or mobile browser. Vela shows your connected address and DOGE balance. Connecting a wallet does not authorize automated trading or move funds.
